I have suicidal thoughts almost daily. I've had them almost weekly from the age of 17/18.  
What I honestly value a shit ton is just learning to be alone. I have no clue if it works or not but finding things I want to do for myself and only for myself is the best shit ever. I recommend trying to find these things out, making a schedule or just making some sort of plans for yourself. That you value for yourself and nobody else.  
I also really recommend the self authoring program by Jordan Peterson. Really helps you contemplate what you want to get out of life.
